query:
INSERT INTO auto_run_tracking (kind, subject_id, count, last_started_at, auto_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
             ON CONFLICT (kind, subject_id) DO UPDATE SET
               count = count + 1,
               last_started_at = excluded.last_started_at,
               auto_at = COALESCE(excluded.auto_at, auto_at)
